items.title: Synopsys vs Cadence: value and quality compared
items.summary: Investing.com -- Synopsys and Cadence have near-identical market caps, but they are priced differently. Synopsys Inc (SNPS) has the stronger forward growth and the cheaper forward multiple. Cadence Design Systems Inc (CDNS) has the cleaner balance sheet and returns on capital. On the numbers below, Synopsys looks like the better value, though Cadence has the better underlying quality.

items.title: Barclays starts Synopsys at Overweight, cites AI R&D tailwinds and EDA dominance
items.summary: Investing.com -- Synopsys Inc (NASDAQ:SNPS) shares gained 1.3% in Thursday trading after Barclays initiated coverage on the chip design software maker with an Overweight rating and a $640 price target. Analyst Saket Kalia highlighted the company’s dominant market positioning and long-term free cash flow trajectory as primary catalysts behind the bullish call.
